definitions.explanation: The player in soccer, hockey, or similar sports who defends the goal and is the only player allowed to use their hands within the penalty area.

examples.japanese: ゴールキーパー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦セーブ→セーブ：11030_seebu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: The goalkeeper made a brilliant save.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ゴールキーパー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He has been playing goalkeeper since childhood.

examples.japanese: ゴールキーパー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}して→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦キャッチ→キャッチ：10873_kyacchi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The goalkeeper came out and caught the ball.

notes:
ゴールキーパー is a loanword from English "goalkeeper," referring to the player who defends the goal in sports like soccer and hockey. In Japanese soccer discussion, the abbreviated forms are far more common in casual speech.

ABBREVIATIONS:
- GK: written abbreviation (in articles, stats, line-ups)
- ⟦キーパー→キーパー：24417_kiipaa⟧: common spoken abbreviation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ゴールキーパー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to play goalkeeper
- ゴールキーパー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as goalkeeper (formal)
- ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧ゴールキーパー: starting goalkeeper
- ⟦{控|ひか}え→控え：15908_hikae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ゴールキーパー: backup goalkeeper

OTHER SOCCER POSITIONS:
- ⟦ディフェンダー→ディフェンダー：06588_difendaa⟧ (DF): defender
- ⟦ミッドフィルダー→ミッドフィルダー：06587_middofirudaa⟧ (MF): midfielder
- ⟦フォワード→フォワード：06586_fowaado⟧ (FW): forward

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦セーブ→セーブ：11030_seebu⟧: save (stopping a shot)
- PK⟦{戦|せん}→戦：28346_sen⟧: penalty shootout
- ⟦{無失点|むしってん}→無失点：noentry⟧: clean sheet (no goals conceded)
